verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs confirm voicemails are transcribed. Users can retrieve missed calls and their voicemail transcripts directly from a chat via Quo's official MCP connectors for Claude/ChatGPT (quo-docs-13, quo-docs-15, quo-docs-7), so they can be read without dialing in. However, this is on-demand retrieval through an AI agent rather than automatic delivery of each voicemail to email or a chat channel. Missing for 10: documented automatic push delivery of voicemail transcripts to email, documented forwarding to team chat apps (e.g., Slack), and independent or hands-on corroboration of transcript quality.
